title: cache: share work within a server request

slides.say: Cache lets Server Components share the result of a fetch or computation.
Call cache outside any component. The first call with some data runs calculate metrics. Later calls with the same data get the cached result.

slides.text: Cache is reset for every server request. Errors are cached too.
slides.say: React invalidates the cache for each server request. And if the function throws, that error is cached too.

slides.text: Each cache() call makes a separate cache. Server Components only.
slides.say: Every call to cache creates a new function with its own cache, so share one memoized function. And cache is for Server Components only.
